articles.title_en: Ukrainian sea drones sink Russian warship in Libya, killing Russians and Libyans
articles.lead_en: The Russian Navy corvette Merkury sank in the Libyan port of Benghazi on November 22 after naval drones struck the warship. An explosion tore through the vessel, igniting a major fire.

articles.title_en: Al Jazeera: Russians, Libyans killed in explosion aboard Russian Navy corvette at Benghazi port
articles.lead_en: An explosion aboard the Russian Navy corvette Merkury, docked at the port of Benghazi, Libya, killed an unspecified number of Russians and Libyans, sources who spoke to the Al Jazeera television network said. The ship sank; photos show only its bow rising above the water’s surface.

articles.title_en: 11 killed in Russian strike on Ukraine’s Dymer in Kyiv region
articles.lead_en: Rescue crews are still clearing rubble in the village of Dymer, in the Kyiv region, after a Russian drone struck a five-story apartment building there overnight on November 22.
